Unit handling: useNativeUnits reads the ported useSettings() query (unit_of_length / locale) so distance ('mi' iff unit_of_length==='mi' else 'km'), speed ('mph' iff 'mi' else 'km/h') and locale reflect the user's preference exactly like web useUnits(); when settings are unset the web defaults ('km', 'km/h', 'en-US') apply. The km->mi and km/h->mi pre-scaling quirks in the source are preserved bit-for-bit so displayed numbers match the web widget.
